sloka: अभ्यगच्छत्ततो रामं विचित्राभरणाम्बरा ।त्रिविष्टपे सहस्राक्षमुपविष्टं यथा शची ।। ७.४२.२८ ॥
transliteration: abhyagacchattato rāmaṁ vicitrābharaṇāmbarā ।triviṣṭape sahasrākṣamupaviṣṭaṁ yathā śacī ।। 7.42.28 ॥

translations.english: Sita also, having performed her morning divine duties, reverently honored all her mothers-in-law without any distinction.
